EDIT ARCT
IF V{MUL}V EQ 1
THEN ANGL=(SIGN V){MUL}{PI}{DIV}4
ELSE VI=(INDEX 5){MUL}2-1
VS=(INDEX 5) MOD 2{MUL}2-1
IF V{MUL}V LT 1
THEN ANGL=+/(V*VI{DIV}VI{MUL}VS)
ELSE ANGL=(SIGN V){MUL}{PI}{DIV}2+(+/(-VS{DIV}(V*VI{MUL}VI)))
ENDI
ENDI
ENDP
ENDE
EDIT ARCC
"INPUT VALUE"
V=KEYB
V=V{DIV}((1-V*V)*0.5)
ARCT
ANGL={PI}{DIV}2-ANGL
"RADIAN ANGLE"
ANGL
ENDP
ENDE
